chunks: Ahmad ibn 'Abdun narrated to me from Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Muhammad ibn al-Zubayr al-Qurashi, from Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Muhammad ibn 'Abdullah ibn Zur'ar, from al-Hasan ibn Ali, from al-'Ala' ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the Imams (peace be upon him), who said:
I asked him about a man who permits the sexual intimacy of his slave-girl to his brother, and he said: 'She is permissible for him as long as he permits her to him.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a man permitting his brother to have sexual relations with his slave-girl?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Istibsar* clarifies the permissibility of *tamattu'* (enjoyment) of a slave-girl by sharing her with another man, provided the owner grants permission. It highlights the flexibility in private ownership rights within Shia jurisprudence, distinguishing this shared use from exclusive ownership. The ruling underscores that the permissibility is contingent upon the continuous consent of the primary owner.
